run_soccerball_simulation: run the pybullet soccerball simulation that loads scaled soccerballs and a plane in GUI mode
load_urdf_soccerball: load a soccerball URDF model into the pybullet physics simulation with a specified global scaling factor
change_dynamics_ball: change the dynamics of a pybullet body to set linear damping, angular damping, and friction values
change_visual_shape_color: change the visual shape RGBA color of a pybullet body to a light gray shade
set_gravity_simulation: set the gravity vector for the pybullet physics simulation to simulate downward acceleration
